recommendation: SQLite: embedded, no extra service to run, survives restarts, fast enough at small scale; switch to Redis only if several app instances on different hosts must share one cache or native TTL/LRU eviction becomes essential
question: For the new small project's cache in front of its search index, should the cache be backed by SQLite or by Redis?

answer: Redis. We will run several copies of the app behind a load balancer, so they need one shared cache. Still do not start any work.
